ideas.title: AI Mentor Platform
ideas.shortDescription: A startup idea for personalized mentorship powered by AI.
ideas.detailedDescription: Mentors and learners connect through AI-driven matching, allowing every startup founder to get feedback quickly.
ideas.problemStatement: Many founders cannot find focused startup advice when they need it.
ideas.proposedSolution: A community platform that pairs ideas with mentor insights using a smart recommendation engine.

ideas.title: Health Habit Tracker
ideas.shortDescription: A collaborative idea validation platform for healthy living habits.
ideas.detailedDescription: Users log habits and receive peer suggestions to refine healthy routines with shared goal tracking.
ideas.problemStatement: Existing habit tools lack community-driven accountability.
ideas.proposedSolution: A social validation system that helps people adjust routines based on shared experience.

ideas.title: Education Micro-Learning
ideas.shortDescription: A startup idea for bite-sized lessons supported by community feedback.
ideas.detailedDescription: Learners share ideas and mentors improve lesson plans through comment-driven iteration.
ideas.problemStatement: Traditional course builders do not capture quick validation from users.
ideas.proposedSolution: A lightweight idea platform where micro-courses are reviewed and refined collaboratively.

ideas.title: Green Tech Network
ideas.shortDescription: A community-driven idea hub for sustainable technology concepts.
ideas.detailedDescription: Inventors and environmental specialists refine green projects through structured idea discussion.
ideas.problemStatement: Sustainable ideas need a dedicated venue for validation and collaboration.
ideas.proposedSolution: A niche network for green concepts and cross-disciplinary feedback.

ideas.title: Remote Team Workshop
ideas.shortDescription: An idea incubator for remote teams to shape product concepts together.
ideas.detailedDescription: Interactive workshops let teams test assumptions and gather insights from expert peers.
ideas.problemStatement: Remote teams struggle to validate ideas without in-person workshops.
ideas.proposedSolution: A digital platform for fast innovation collaboration and idea reviews.

ideas.title: AI Customer Voice
ideas.shortDescription: A feedback engine that captures customer problems and proposed solutions.
ideas.detailedDescription: Startups collect real product needs and validate them via community commentary.
ideas.problemStatement: Product ideas often miss proven customer validation early enough.
ideas.proposedSolution: A platform that surfaces customer voice and lets founders refine product direction.
